label: Reconcile screen words

params.name: lede
params.default: Books against the Income-tax portal: 26AS, AIS and TIS. Only rows with a saved or file SF Ref count from the books.
params.label: lede

params.name: no_files
params.default: No portal files yet. Upload the 26AS text export from TRACES, or AIS / TIS as CSV or Excel.
params.label: no files

params.name: pan_missing
params.default: client PAN not found in this file
params.label: pan missing

params.name: delete_body
params.default: The portal file is removed; findings are worked out again without it.
params.label: delete body

params.name: explain_hint
params.default: Why it is fine, or what was done. Clear the box to remove the note.
params.label: explain hint

params.name: nothing
params.default: Upload a portal file to see findings.
params.label: nothing

params.name: tds_red
params.default: TDS from {party}: 26AS shows {portal}, the books claim {books}.
params.label: tds red

params.name: tds_amber
params.default: TDS of {portal} from {party} is in 26AS but not in the books - credit left unclaimed?
params.label: tds amber

params.name: tds_claim_red
params.default: The books claim TDS of {books} from {party}, which 26AS does not show - the credit will be refused.
params.label: tds claim red

params.name: income_ok
params.default: {head}: books {books} cover the {portal} the portal reports.
params.label: income ok

params.name: income_red
params.default: {head}: the portal reports {portal}, the books show {books} - {gap} of income may be missing.
params.label: income red

params.name: paid_amber
params.default: Tax paid {amount} on {date} is in 26AS but not in the books.
params.label: paid amber

params.name: paid_claim_red
params.default: The books show tax paid {amount} ({label}) that 26AS does not.
params.label: paid claim red

params.name: too_big
params.default: That file is larger than {mb} MB.
params.label: too big

params.name: nothing_read
params.default: Nothing could be read from {name} - is it a 26AS, AIS or TIS export?
params.label: nothing read

params.name: same_file
params.default: {name} is already uploaded for this year.
params.label: same file

params.name: no_finding
params.default: That finding is no longer there.
params.label: no finding

params.name: blocked
params.default: {n} red finding(s) in Reconcile have no explanation yet - clear or explain them before moving to {stage}.
params.label: blocked
